links.outcome: Nutrient estimation error (MAE) of MLLM grounded via RAG in FNDDS versus commercial and computer vision baselines
links.effect: 63% reduction in MAE for food weight and four key nutrients versus existing methods on real-world mixed dishes (p < 0.05); 65 nutrients estimated.
links.quote: DietAI24 demonstrates that integrating MLLMs with RAG and standardized nutrition databases can substantially improve dietary assessment accuracy while enabling comprehensive nutrient analysis.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates DietAI24, testing the impact of grounding multimodal LLM outputs using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) against an authoritative nutrition database (FNDDS) on benchmark datasets (ASA24, Nutrition5k).

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding with authoritative database
